scope: UI and authenticated Control client image-event handling in the uncommitted integration worktree. Tests use synthetic Run events and artifact bytes; final production browser, full UI build, provider, and installed-app verification are owned by the root coordinator.
behavior: model.image.progress immediately projects an imageGeneration item. stage=completed waits for model.image.generated before claiming success.
Live streaming, settlement backfill, fresh runtime history hydration, and first-fragment transcript-window rendering share the same small artifact metadata projection.
Image results render directly in the conversation outside the collapsed process group. PNG, JPEG, and WebP previews include a Save image download link.
artifactRef is the existing opaque artifactId and is passed unchanged to ControlApiClient.downloadArtifact. The client retains authentication and digest verification and bounds the response at 8 MiB.
The preview checks MIME, metadata byte length, and raster file signature before creating a Blob URL. No base64 or image bytes enter Thread history or persistent UI state.
Unmount, artifact changes, and identity changes abort reads and revoke object URLs. Old identity callbacks cannot populate a new preview. A stalled read fails after 30 seconds with a reload action.
Failed or canceled runs without an artifact produce an explicit image-generation failure. Expired, inaccessible, malformed, or undecodable images show a plain-language load failure and retry.

Image projection retains at most 16 image references per Run and reports incomplete history if that bound is exceeded. Older image items without an artifact retain their saved-path notice without rendering inline result/base64 text.
